area: Builders: day-to-day admin on Bulk changes (ZIA users, groups, departments and PAC files; ZIdentity users and API clients)
title: Day-to-day admin types on the shared engine: Scope rule, four gates, plan hash, re-read, read-back, Undo, audit with actor, secrets shown once

checks.what: Every new type out of scope (ZIA platform / ZIdentity not ticked) is refused before sign-in and reads nothing: plan, apply, picker, every route
Four gates before sign-in for every new type (cross-plugin tables in test_sbd_writes)

Payload oracles: every write body has only fields of the SDK 1.11.3 model (UserManagement, Groups, Department, PacFiles, UserRecord, APIClientRecords, ClientAuthentication, ClientResources) or of the object as read; never a password
Deletes ask DELETE <name> (or DELETE <n> OBJECTS) every time, rotation ROTATE <name>; blank, wrong and look-alike text write nothing; the preview says what cannot be undone
A new API client secret (and one in the create's answer) is in no result, job log, change record, Undo preview, audit log, store file or server log; revealed once, to the person who applied, no-store
PAC never run: parsed by pac_eval (a looping PAC is refused in words), checked by ZIA's validator; refused text blocks the plan; text over 256 KB or with control characters refused before a read
Defaults off: new ZIdentity users and API clients created disabled, new PAC versions STAGED, no scope preselected; full-access scopes flagged (least privilege)
Admin accounts, predefined and IdP groups, SCIM users and this app's own API client are left alone with the reason
Moved tenant: plan_changed, nothing written; re-read conflict right before a write is skipped; Undo-only inverses refused without undo_of

findings.title: Zscaler SDK 1.11.3 ZIdentity models drop data a read needs: ServiceScopes.request_format omits a resource server's scopes, and get_api_client_secret parses the list of secrets into one empty object
findings.fix: ops_zid and ops_zia_directory read the raw answer when the SDK response carries it (ops_zia_directory.raw_body); secret values are dropped from every read (ops_zid.scrub)

findings.title: During development: a new PAC version's plan hash did not cover the source version's text, so a version edited in the portal after the preview would still be cloned from
findings.fix: the plan and the handler carry the source version's digest; a changed source gives plan_changed

notes: Not possible with zscaler-sdk-python 1.11.3 and so not offered (the page says so): resetting a ZIdentity user's password or MFA (zid/users.py has list, get, add, update, delete and list_user_group_details only; UserRecord has no password or MFA field) and disabling a ZIA user (UserManagement has no enabled or status field).

Assumed (marked in the module docstrings): ZIA refuses a duplicate user email; the PAC DEPLOY action takes the version's fields as read; PAC changes wait for activation; a new API client has no secret until one is added; ZIdentity PUTs take the object as read; the OAuth client ID is the API client's id; a missing object answers 404.
